examples.title: UI kit gallery
examples.summary: Every irender-ui-kit component: buttons, cards, form controls and tables; dialogs, sheets, menus, popovers, tabs and toasts; and a react-select-style combobox with search, multi-select, groups, async and creatable options.

examples.title: Blocks
examples.summary: Whole pages in the style of shadcn/ui's blocks: a dashboard with an inset sidebar, summary cards, an interactive area chart and a paged, selectable table, and a ⌘K command palette; sidebars that collapse to icons or slide away; login, sign-up, settings and pricing pages, and a theme customizer.

examples.title: Chart kit gallery
examples.summary: Apache ECharts through irender-chart-kit: every ECharts category in ui-kit cards, drill-downs from region to city, cross-filtering by click, date range, legend and brush, and live charts fed by polling and server-sent events.

examples.title: Flow
examples.summary: Node-and-edge diagrams through irender-flow-kit, each previewed live: a package's ER diagram and a process canvas laid out in several ways (in a card, filling the screen, beside a list, as a map), an editable workflow, containers, a flowchart and plain React Flow JSON.

examples.title: Maps
examples.summary: Maps through irender-map-kit, on OpenStreetMap with no key or on Google Maps: markers and popups of any components, clusters, picking a place, dragging stops, lines, circles and GeoJSON, with what's selected and in view as state.

examples.title: Digital twins
examples.summary: 3D worlds through irender-twin-kit and three.js, from glTF, OBJ, STL and other models (NVIDIA SimReady here): everything in them configuration, machine and sensor data on the objects with limits and alarms, colours by value, paths, popups of any components, live feeds and editing a layout.

examples.title: Icon gallery
examples.summary: Every irender-icon-kit pack: original icons for everyday interfaces, logistics, warehouses, retail, manufacturing, accounting, agriculture, automotive, aviation, banking, construction, education, energy, finance, healthcare, hospitality, HR, insurance, IT, legal, marketing, maritime, media, mining, oil and gas, public sector, robotics, simulation, social networks, space, sports and telecom, each in an outline and a filled style, plus brand logos, at several sizes, in buttons, and switched by state.
